subject: Mythology
title: Yomi: The Land of the Dead
description: A quick, practical guide to Yomi: The Land of the Dead.

hook.text: When Izanagi went to rescue his dead wife, he found a dark realm of decay where the dead slowly rotted forever.

buildup.text: Izanami begged him not to look at her. She said she needed to ask permission from the lords of Yomi to leave.

discovery.text: Impatient, Izanagi lit a torch and saw her body crawling with maggots and surrounded by thunder demons.

twist.text: Enraged that he saw her true form, Izanami sent armies of the dead to chase him back to the living world.

climax.text: He sealed the entrance with a boulder. She screamed that she would kill a thousand living people each day.

punchline.text: Japan explains death as a broken promise between two lovers.

quiz.question: Why did Izanami turn against Izanagi?
options: He refused to stay with her in the underworld
He broke his promise and looked at her decaying form
He remarried another goddess while she was trapped
